LanguageData.Gun_Browning_Hi-Power_P35_RWP.label: Browning Hi-Power P35
LanguageData.Gun_Browning_Hi-Power_P35_RWP.descriptio: A classic semi-automatic pistol known for its reliability and accuracy. The Browning Hi-Power P35 delivers a balanced rate of fire with moderate stopping power and a high-capacity magazine, making it a versatile sidearm for various combat scenarios.
